capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Battery Design (reverse-engineering blog, not the maker) gives total 94 kWh; 87.9 net cited to Rivian engineers.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: The Drive: 87.9-kWh pack on Performance, Premium and Standard Long Range; Battery Design: 87.9 net (EPA-certified usable 86.8).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: LG 4695 high-nickel NCMA cells (reverse-engineered from EPA data, not stated by Rivian); recorded as nmc, the closest schema value.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: InsideEVs: Rivian stuck with a 400 V architecture for the R2 (Battery Design: 353 V nominal).

preconditioning.notes: Weak estimate; no R2 trigger described on any page read. Estimated: Rivian charging page says the battery is warmed or cooled for charging and covers the R2; the R1 gets navigation plus manual preconditioning (software 2025.18, InsideEVs); no R2-specific page describing the controls was found.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Electrek reads the EPA certification data as "seems capable of a peak DC rate of 217kW"; not a maker statement. Battery Design says 230 kW.
InsideEVs measured a peak of 229 kW (State of Charge test: 226 kW). Which value is the display default is an owner call.

ac_max_kw.notes: Charged EVs: R2 Level 2 charging is rated at 11 kW (11 kW bidirectional). No Rivian R2 spec page found; R1 is 11.5 kW.

published_10_80_min.notes: Rivian claim relayed by Electrek: 10-80 % in about 29 min (also The Drive, Battery Design).
